purpose: A phone e-card behind a contact link or QR code, shown for the template's sample person Isabel Navarro, partner success lead: save the contact in one tap, then email, call, connect on LinkedIn or book a call.

seo.title: Isabel Navarro | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Sample digital business card: save Isabel Navarro’s contact, email her or book a call with Alliance AI Partners.
seo.robots: noindex (cards are reached by link or QR code, not search)

sections.name: Card head
sections.job: Say who this is and where they work: mark and name, role, the company line.
sections.mobile: Built first. A Partner Navy band at full width: Logo/Primary horizontal/Full colour dark at 56 px (the 3D mark stays above its 48 px minimum), the name in Display/LG, the role in Body/LG, the company and base in Data/Mono. The satin ribbon (the page's one signature) runs out of the band: its navy end lies on Daylight at the left, its cyan end rises into the navy at the right, as in brand-kit/templates/digital-business-card.html.
sections.desktop: The same head as the top of a 400-wide card (28 px radius, Lifted shadow) centred on a Daylight page; the ribbon is clipped by the card.
components: Ribbon (vector, gradient strokes bound to the brand variables)

images.source: Satin ribbon: a 26 px band (Partner Navy to Alliance Blue at 54% to Ribbon Cyan) with an 8 px lit edge (Ribbon 57 to Ribbon Cyan) shifted up 9 px, the template's path M-30 344 C92 346 190 322 262 298 S362 262 420 254.

sections.name: Card body
sections.job: Save the contact in one tap, then the ways to reach her, the QR placeholder and the company line.
sections.mobile: Primary 'Save contact' full width LG with the download icon; four hairline contact rows (icon, caption label, value): Mobile +1 202 555 0147 in Data/Mono with a 'Sample' tag, Email, LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/[profile], Website; Secondary 'Book a call with Isabel' full width with the calendar icon; the QR placeholder (dashed, three finder squares, 'QR sample') beside 'Scan to save this contact', 'Placeholder, not scannable' and the vCard URL; the company line (the tagline and the one-sentence pitch); a sample note and the privacy link.
sections.desktop: The same body inside the card (white, raised), 352 px of content width; a caption under the card marks it as a sample.

body: Partners in AI. Partners in growth.
Alliance AI Partners helps companies put AI to work so they can grow faster.
Sample card. Isabel Navarro is a sample person, and these details are samples.

images.source: QR placeholder drawn in Figma (white tile, dashed Neutral 500 edge, three Partner Navy finder squares, 'QR sample'); not scannable until the domain and vCard URL exist (brand-kit/templates/README.md, QR code).

sections.note: The email breaks after the @ (set by hand in Figma; in code use overflow-wrap: anywhere with a <wbr> after the @, as the template does).

notes: Mobile-first: the Mobile frame (390, x 1600) was built first; the Desktop frame (1440, x 0) centres the same card, 400 wide with a 28 px radius, a hairline and the Lifted shadow, on a Daylight page, and sets the card to the Mobile viewport mode so its type stays at phone sizes. Like the brand-kit template it has no site header or footer: the card's own logo carries the brand, and the page is reached by a link or a QR code. One Primary, Save contact (mobile y 397, desktop y 494); Book a call is Secondary. The ribbon is the page's one signature: two vectors (band and lit edge) inside a 'Ribbon' frame, their gradient stops bound to the Partner Navy, Alliance Blue, Ribbon 57 and Ribbon Cyan variables. Sample data only, from brand-kit/templates/README.md: Isabel Navarro (partner success lead) is a sample person and appears on no other page; +1 202 555 0147 is in the range kept for fiction and carries a 'Sample' tag; the domain is allianceaipartners.example; the LinkedIn profile stays [profile]; the QR is a labelled placeholder, not scannable. A sample note sits above the privacy link. The amber 'Placeholder, not scannable' uses the warning text colour (#8A5800, 5.62:1 on Daylight). Lint clean on both frames.
